repositoryBoundary: Only CFR end-user portal, Super Admin console, shared platform packages, central registry, and universal App Switcher live in this repository.
externalApplicationModel: Each business application owns its repository, domain, deployment pipeline, data boundary, and application session.
authenticationModel: CFR and Admin use the platform auth adapter; independent domains federate through OIDC/OAuth in production. Browser cookies are not shared across unrelated domains.
launcherIntegration: Any web platform loads the versioned app-switcher script and renders the catholic-solutions-app-switcher custom element.
packagePolicy: Use current stable, mutually compatible packages; defer breaking majors until toolchain compatibility is verified in CI.
externalSaasModel: All business products, including OptionC School, Parish Hub, Matt Money, ArcAlerts and partner SaaS, are independently deployed and registered once in packages/app-registry. App Hub state and launcher publication are controlled separately from deployment location.
launcherMembership: v1.6.7-compatible: publish only Your Apps and Available Apps that are launcher-enabled and have approved destinations; Future Apps never appear in the launcher.
externalSourceDistribution: Actual v1.6.7 business-app source is distributed as separate sibling repositories under External_SaaS_Apps in the source bundle; it is not part of the Catholic_Solutions workspace.
